title: The feature cycle, end to end
intro: One feature, one branch, three documents — the loop you'll run for every roadmap phase.

steps.title: Fresh context, own branch
steps.body: Every feature starts with a **fresh agent context** — the agent pulls what it needs from the constitution, the official source — and its **own branch** (`phase-1-hello-hono`). A clean slate per feature means less context switching and reviewable diffs.

steps.title: The spec comes before the code
steps.body: In a dated dir (`specs/2026-03-30-hello-hono/`), the agent — after **interviewing you** — writes the feature-spec triple, referring back to `mission.md` and `tech-stack.md`:

points.label: plan.md
points.note: Numbered task groups — the sequence of the work.

points.label: requirements.md
points.note: Scope, decisions and context surfaced by the interview: pinned versions, strict TypeScript, stakeholder notes.

points.label: validation.md
points.note: The done-and-mergeable criteria — written before any code exists.

steps.title: Implement, then validate at altitude
steps.body:
With the spec **committed**, implementation is nearly a one-liner: *"implement this plan."*

Review the result **high-level**: does it work, does it reflect the spec? Don't sweat CSS class names. When you spot a gap, **fix the spec and the code together, through the agent** — it re-validates after each change (typecheck + smoke) so nothing silently breaks.

steps.title: The enemy is drift
steps.body:
> [!warn] Hand-editing code leaves the spec describing software that no longer exists. That's **drift**, and it rebuilds **cognitive debt** — the mental load of tracking what changed and why — which is exactly what SDD exists to remove.

Finish the loop: mark the roadmap phase complete, merge the branch, delete it. Small constitution touches (checking off a phase) ride the feature branch; bigger constitution changes deserve their own.

recap:
**Branch → interview → plan/requirements/validation → commit spec → implement → validate → merge.**

- Fresh context per feature; the constitution is the source of truth.
- Validation criteria are written before the code.
- Review at altitude; route every fix through the agent to keep spec and code in sync.
- Drift = specs lying about the code; it is the failure mode to guard against.
